title: Scoreboard
description: A hand-operated ballpark scoreboard in low evening sun, bottom of the 6th. Lift a tin number plate off the rack and hang it in any inning: it swings from where you hold it, drops onto its rails with a clank, and the runs total slides its own plates to keep up.
intent: One physical object finished to the edge: weathered painted steel and dented tin plates under raking golden-hour light, where every plate has weight, swings on your grip and seats with a clank.
